moved.title: 低风险变更批量结算
moved.reason: Batch settlement first changes adoptable contract fields; RP2 only records provisional assumptions.

moved.title: 选择成本预览
moved.reason: Story-effect and rework previews require concrete contract candidates.

moved.title: 审阅压缩
moved.reason: Candidate review compression starts when the first adoptable contract candidate exists.

moved.title: 协作强度自适应
moved.reason: Adaptive collaboration intensity requires longitudinal behavior and rollback evidence.

moved.title: 精力与价值联合评估
moved.reason: Effort-to-value optimization is a longitudinal product metric, not an understanding prerequisite.

moved.title: 内容寻址缓存
moved.reason: Content-addressed cache optimization is valuable but not required to prove the first governed interpretation call; it is first consumed by repeated drafting calls.

moved.title: 多层目标与继承
moved.reason: Cross-level objective inheritance starts when volume, arc, chapter, and scene scopes exist.

moved.title: 优先级不是永久权重
moved.reason: Stage-dependent objective weighting is first applied to prose generation and review.

moved.title: 近期与远期双层成功条件
moved.reason: Near-term versus long-term contribution requires planned arcs and work items.

moved.title: 反目标守卫
moved.reason: Anti-goal extraction is understood in V2, but the independent generation guard is first consumed by drafting.

moved.title: 目标可验证但不指标投机
moved.reason: Anti-metric-gaming is not needed for the first interpretation call, but it is required as soon as the first prose objective is evaluated.

moved.title: 目标变更影响分析
moved.reason: Cross-asset objective-change impact begins after authored assets and evaluation history exist.

moved.title: 候选比较按缺口而非总分
moved.reason: Gap-based candidate comparison begins with multiple contract candidates.

moved.title: 目标漂移监控
moved.reason: Objective drift requires chapter settlements and historical target versions.

moved.title: Q-003 参数槽
moved.reason: Q-003 changes drafting quality, review depth, and budget parameters rather than understanding semantics.

conclusion: RP2 retains truth-bounded interpretation, Socratic questioning, red-blue evidence, effort gates, and first-call AI/context safety; downstream optimization no longer counts in its denominator.
